name: sandbox
description: Project-owned persistent environments, shared worktrees and lifecycle management, with preserved legacy account workspaces.

configSchema.label: Execution
configSchema.hint: How commands from accounts without instance-operator authority are contained.

configSchema.label: Confine non-operator commands
configSchema.hint: Run non-operator commands in bubblewrap with only their accessible Projects, workspaces and account HOME mounted. Network access remains available. If the live namespace probe fails, execution is refused rather than run unconfined.

strings.workspacesHint: Account-scoped Git worktrees for parallel branches. One workspace can be active per conversation and Project.
strings.loadError: Environment data could not be loaded.
strings.label: Label
strings.commitPathsHint: One workspace-relative path per line. Only these paths are staged.
strings.removeCleanDescription: The clean worktree and its generated branch will be removed.
strings.discardWarning: This workspace contains local changes or commits outside its base ref. Review the loss preview and type the exact phrase to continue.
strings.environmentHint: HOME, execution mode and Git identity for this account.
strings.networkCaveat: Confined commands keep network access for package installation, Git and development servers.
strings.resetWarning: This removes account-scoped Git, npm and tool configuration. Workspaces are preserved. Active processes block the reset.
strings.migrationCollision: Legacy HOME migration requires operator attention before this environment is safe to use.
strings.error_project_forbidden: This Project is no longer accessible.
strings.error_workspace_not_clean: The workspace is not clean. Use the loss preview in the browser or preserve the work.
strings.error_workspace_in_use: An active process is using this workspace.
strings.error_workspace_changed: The workspace changed after the preview. Refresh and review it again.
strings.error_home_in_use: An active process is using this HOME.
strings.error_home_changed: HOME changed after the preview. Refresh and review it again.
strings.error_confirmation_mismatch: The confirmation phrase does not match.
strings.projectTrust: Every project member has full access to this environment, including all worktrees and guest browser profiles. Worktrees separate unfinished work, not access. Outbound access includes internal services.
strings.projectCredentials: Personal integration credentials stay outside the environment. Credentials and exported results stored here are shared project data.
strings.operationRequested: Operation requested. Completion is reported by the environment.
strings.stopWarning: Stop the project environment? Commands and project services will be interrupted. Files and installed packages are preserved.
strings.snapshotWarning: A complete snapshot includes the root filesystem, files, Git worktrees, HOME and data while execution is paused. It is crash-consistent, not database-consistent. Application databases may require a separate export.
strings.restoreWarning: Replace the environment with this snapshot? Changes since the snapshot will be lost and running work will be interrupted.
strings.deleteProjectWarning: Delete the project, environment and all its files, packages, HOME and data? Published sites must be transferred or deleted separately. Personal conversation history is preserved. Cleanup completion is reported asynchronously.
strings.diskSoftHint: The disk threshold is advisory, not an enforced quota.
strings.error_request_unresolved: A previous request has not been acknowledged. Retry that action or refresh its status before starting a different operation.
strings.error_request_state_invalid: The saved environment request is invalid. Verify the current operations before clearing browser data.
